purpose: Additional net gain caused by SM/address affinity over frozen vector fast baseline. Ordinary implementation speedups alone do not satisfy.
primary_scope: KV append plus paged GQA output ready; exact previous vector fast baseline
claim_rule: Positive independent process-level lower CI against frozen fast AND same-overhead blind; inverse/shuffle/actual trace support required for address attribution. No selective deletion.
statistics: Paired per-block median log time ratios; offsets equal then cases equal; process clustered bootstrap. 95% aggregate; four per-case exploratory 98.75% family intervals. No replay pseudo-replication.
stage1: One CTA claims a complete precompiled address-colored page job once, no per-page atomics; identical attention arithmetic. CA and CG as separate controlled variants.
stage2_if_needed: If stage1 fails, use a predeclared separately documented LLM memory/gather/reduction component with strong blind same-geometry baseline; record selection before new holdout.
